TZA.note: Only a disability action plan with nothing on information or digital services.

facts.fact: Human Rights Watch says the government imposed nationwide internet restrictions in response to election-day protests in October 2025.
Human Rights Watch says the government blocked access to X in May 2025, and that TCRA had shut over 80,000 websites, accounts and platforms.
Human Rights Watch says TCRA suspended the web forum JamiiForums for 90 days in September 2025 for allegedly publishing content that insulted and disrespected the government and the President.
